source: requirements derived from assembly function; not generated by CAD

interfaces.required: Measured hub/bore/bolt pattern, shaft axis, pulley ratio and axial stack
interfaces.load_path: Fan centrifugal and belt/drive loads into bearing carrier

interfaces.required: Selected alternator, envelope, mounts, electrical/cooling passages
interfaces.load_path: Alternator mass and drive loads into carrier

interfaces.required: Engine case attachment faces, fasteners and cylinder/head sealing edges
interfaces.load_path: Shroud pressure and vibration into case mounts

interfaces.required: Six cylinder/head envelopes, fin passages and seal datums
interfaces.load_path: Flow to measured fin passages; no invented bolt holes

interfaces.required: Wing underside, engine lid travel, hinge and service keep-outs
interfaces.load_path: Core and tanks into engine/body mounts, flexible couplers isolate motion

interfaces.required: Two compressor outlet routes and throttle/inlet connections
interfaces.load_path: Boost pressure and hose reactions into supported tanks
